about: The five criteria every package and the final package are scored on, 0 to 10 each. Weights sum to 100. The engine computes totals from these; judges only write the per-criterion scores.

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.question: How many cells of the union completeness matrix does the package fill with a concrete answer: a number, an owner, a rule, a state, a fallback?

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.question: How many scenario probes does the package survive when traced through its own rules: blocked when it should block, allowed when it should allow, defined where it must be defined?

criteria.name: Task fit
criteria.question: Does it do exactly what the task asked: nothing from the task missing, nothing invented beyond it?

criteria.name: Coherence
criteria.question: Do the rules agree with each other across files; does every state have a way out; does every rule have a number and an owner; could Claude Code build it from TASKS.md without guessing?

criteria.name: Simplicity
criteria.question: For the same completeness, is this the less complicated design to build, run and explain?
